9:t_1:3.en:
$$キング$$
「...So this day has finally come...」

9:t_1:4.en:
$$キング$$
「Now all our efforts, and our very existence, will come to nothing...」

9:t_1:6.en:
$$キング$$
「But we may at least avert a future of despair...」

9:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This scenario has no $$Ｄトレーダー$$, but scenario demo 10 is included just in case.」

10:t_000:1.en:
$$レイアム$$
「We've lost contact with all $c ships. $$地球連邦軍$$ fleets in every area have reportedly been destroyed or withdrawn.」

10:t_000:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The $$連邦軍$$ are exhausted by the loss of their main force, controlled by 《$$クロノ$$》, and the fighting with $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

10:t_000:3.en:
$$キャシー$$
「I can't believe we have to face a new enemy in this condition...」

10:t_000:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「For now, let's do what we can. At the very least, we'll hold this area at all costs.」

10:t_000:5.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Three minutes until contact with the enemy $$サイデリアル$$ forces...」

10:t_000:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Our current position is this area's last line of defense.」

10:t_000:7.en:
$$テッサ$$
(The Absolute Earth Defense Plan... If it had gone ahead, we could have handled a situation like this...)

10:t_000:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「You heard her, all units. If they break through here, the enemy forces will descend to Earth.」

10:t_000:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If that happens, Earth will...」

10:t_000:12.en:
$$リディ$$
「But even if we win, that's only one area...」

10:t_000:15.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Even so, we have no choice but to fight.」

10:t_000:17.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're ready, all of you...!? Here they come!」

10:t_001:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Be careful! An even larger force is waiting behind them!」

10:t_001:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then we'll drag them out and crush them, too!」

10:t_001:6.en:
$n
「I don't have time to complain...! Let's go!」

10:t_003:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Damn it! How much firepower do they have!?」

10:t_003:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「That ship that stands out...! Is that the flagship!?」

10:t_004:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The wielder of the $$沈黙の巨蟹$$ 《$$スフィア$$》...!」

10:t_004:2.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「My subordinates will deal with you. ...Let's go, $$ストラウス$$.」

10:t_005:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「They're breaking through our defense line!」

10:t_005:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All units, turn around! Pursue them!」

10:t_006:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Are you trying to hold us here!?」

10:t_006:2.en:
$$尸刻$$
「My orders are to eliminate you.」

10:t_006:4.en:
$$尸刻$$
「My name is $$尸刻$$... I am the deputy commander of $$鬼宿$$.」

10:t_006:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「So you're one of $$尸空#pilot$$'s people...!」

10:t_006:8.en:
$$尸刻$$
「You should have stayed there and rotted away in that person's mercy...」

10:t_006:9.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Too bad for you! We chose to live for the future!」

10:t_006:10.en:
$$甲児$$
「And to beat anyone like you who targets Earth with their self-serving excuses!」

10:t_006:11.en:
$$尸刻$$
「...That person's sorrow does not reach you...」

10:t_006:12.en:
$$尸刻$$
「All units, spread out. We will carry out our mission.」

10:t_006:14.en:
$$隼人$$
「We can't pursue that fleet with these enemies in our way! Let's do this!」

10:t_006:15.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All units, be careful! Their mass-produced machines perform better than those we've fought before!」

10:t_006:16.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Our target is the enemy commander who calls herself $$尸刻$$! Concentrate your attacks on her!」

10:t_006:17.en:
$$尸刻$$
「The time has come for you to learn you were being protected... Your defeat is inevitable.」

10:t_007:0.en:
$$尸刻$$
「...I see. It is no wonder $$ジェミニス$$ could not defeat you.」

10:t_007:1.en:
$$尸刻$$
「But I have fulfilled the minimum requirements of my mission. All units, withdraw.」

10:t_008:0.en:
$$尸刻$$
「...I see. It is no wonder $$ジェミニス$$ could not defeat you.」

10:t_008:1.en:
$$尸刻$$
「But I have fulfilled the minimum requirements of my mission. I am withdrawing.」

10:t_009:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「The enemy commander has withdrawn. ...Shall we pursue, Captain?」

10:t_009:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「Which one? That woman? Or the fleet that descended to Earth?」

10:t_009:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Even so, we must keep fighting.」

10:t_010:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Our strength exists to protect peace. We cannot abandon that responsibility.」

10:t_010:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We still have the will to fight. That is our hope.」
